name: Nectar
oneLiner: NECT is Beraborrow's Liquity v2-style overcollateralized stablecoin on Berachain, minted against iBGT, WBERA, BTC/ETH variants, and Kodiak Island LPs.
collateral: Berachain-native Collateral Vault branches: iBGT (Infrared liquid staked BGT), iBERA, WBERA, pumpBTC, solvBTC, solvBTC.bbn, uniBTC, beraETH, Stakestone ETH, WETH, ylstETH, rsETH, and Kodiak Island LP pairs (WBTC-HONEY, WETH-HONEY, WETH-WBTC)
pegMechanism: Overcollateralized CDP with redemption for collateral at $1 face value (Liquity-style); operates on Berachain (not Ethereum or a Stage 1 L2)

oracleRisk.summary: At Berachain block 24033076, 13 positive-debt Beraborrow collateral branches route through a central PriceFeed. Direct branches use configured RedStone adapters with validation and no live failover; Kodiak Island LP branches compose those values; the sunsetting ylstETH branch uses an owner-set conversion rate and is separately rated single-source-or-laggy.

branchApplicability.reviewer: Codex Safety Score V9 ORCL curation
branchApplicability.rationale: The deployed-address inventory identifies 13 current Collateral Vault/DenManager branches. At pinned Berachain block 24033076 each DenManager had positive system debt, including six sunsetting branches with zero maxSystemDebt, so each remains liquidation-active and needs a branch-specific oracle and liquidation row.

branches.label: WBERA collateral branch
branches.summary: WBERA collateral branch uses the central Beraborrow PriceFeed and a configured RedStone BERA/USD adapter external price source for collateral health and liquidation.

feeds.path: RedStone BERA/USD adapter answer -> Beraborrow PriceFeed -> Collateral Vault/DebtManager ICR

branches.fallbackBehavior: PriceFeed requires valid current and previous oracle rounds, rejects stale answers and over-50% consecutive-round moves, and reverts rather than invoking an alternate live provider.

collateralParameters.note: Active with positive system debt at pinned block 24033076; MCR is enforced by this DenManager branch.

branches.liquidationMechanism: LiquidationManager permits public liquidation below branch MCR. The Liquid Stability Pool first offsets NECT debt against seized collateral; any uncovered debt and collateral are redistributed to active positions in the branch.
branches.backstop: The global Liquid Stability Pool is the first-loss backstop. When deposits do not cover a liquidation, the DenManager redistributes the residual debt and collateral across active positions.
branches.shutdownOrBadDebtBehavior: Oracle reads revert when the configured source is stale, invalid, or exceeds the PriceFeed consecutive-round deviation check; the reviewed contracts expose no alternate live feed. A sunsetting branch disables new borrowing and collateral handoff to the Stability Pool while existing positions and redistributed debt remain.

blacklistabilityReview.evidence: Re-verified at Berachain block 24601923 (2026-08-08T19:49:22Z) against the verified multi-collateral DebtToken source. The canonical NECT deployment remained direct bytecode with a zero EIP-1967 implementation slot. Ordinary transfer and transferFrom have no blacklist or pause check, but burn(address _account,uint256 _amount) calls _burn(_account,_amount) without allowance for any caller in denManagers or PSMBonds. The WBERA DenManager 0xf1356cb726c2988c65c5313350c9115d9af0f954 remained actively whitelisted, and a fixed-block eth_call from that address to burn an unrelated address with amount zero succeeded, proving the live authorization path; the constructor PSMBond placeholder 0x000000000000000000000000000000000000dead also remained whitelisted. The reviewed 4-of-7 Safe behind the three-day owner path can additionally whitelist another PSM bond. NECT therefore has a current direct arbitrary-holder burn capability even though ordinary transfers remain open and the present DenManager uses it for protocol mechanics.
blacklistabilityReview.reviewer: Codex C10 wave1 control review; Kimi T44 unknown-reduction wave-2

Beraborrow retains admin/governance control over collateral branch onboarding (some collateral is permissioned); renouncement is not confirmed.

controls.label: NECT token / registered Beraborrow branch minters
controls.capDescription: NECT mints only via registered Beraborrow collateral-vault (Den) branches against overcollateralized positions, with Liquity-style $1-face-value redemptions; supply is bounded by collateralized borrowing. Branch registration and debt ceilings are controlled by the Registry owner (4-of-7 Beraborrow Safe behind a 3-day timelock), which can raise mint capacity by registering new branches or adjusting parameters.
controls.evidence: Beraborrow docs describe Dens depositing collateral to mint the overcollateralized stablecoin NECT (Liquity v2-style), with NECT token at 0x1cE0a25D13CE4d52071aE7e02Cf1F6606F4C79d3.

controls.label: Beraborrow Registry owner Safe (4/7) with 3-day timelock
controls.capDescription: 4-of-7 Beraborrow Safe owns the Registry contract (which controls branch/minter registration for NECT), subject to a 3-day timelock (259,200 seconds). NECT token has no owner() function and no OpenZeppelin Ownable/AccessControl — minting is whitelisted via TroveManagers/BorrowerOperations/DebtManager mappings controlled by the Registry.
controls.evidence: At Berachain block 22088792, NECT token (0x1ce0a25d) has no owner() (reverts), no Ownable/AccessControl in bytecode. Mint requires caller in TroveManagers (slot 8), BorrowerOperations (slot 11), or DebtManager (slot 12) mappings. Registry at 0x27393e8a owner() returned 0xce7d3fd53c0510325b3cebb96298522e6c538753 (Gnosis Safe L2, masterCopy 0x3e5c6364). RPC getOwners() returned 7 signers, getThreshold() returned 4. Registry timelock delay = 0x3f480 = 259200s (3 days). Safe modules/guard not confirmed via Safe API (Berachain Safe API endpoint unclear). Direct Berachain RPC reads at block 22089745: getOwners() returned 7 owners, getThreshold()=4, no modules, no guard, masterCopy GnosisSafeL2 v1.3.0.

review.evidence: At Berachain block 22088792: NECT token has no Ownable/AccessControl in bytecode; owner() reverts; mint() reverts with 'Debt: Caller not BO/DM' (whitelisted contract minting). Registry at 0x27393e8a6f8f2e32b870903279999c820e984dc7 owned by 0xce7d3fd5 (4/7 Gnosis Safe L2, confirmed via RPC getOwners/getThreshold), timelock delay 3 days. Control is NOT renounced — Safe retains authority to add branch minters via Registry. Reclassification to immutable-user-collateralized is NOT appropriate. Berachain RPC reads at block 22089745 resolved the Registry owner Safe: getModulesPaginated returned no modules and the guard slot is zero, clearing the final modules/guards blocker.
